name: MinuteCryptic
description: Can an LLM solve British-style cryptic crossword clues (definition + wordplay) from minutecryptic.com?

binding_vow.description: One cryptic clue per episode. The agent sees the clue text and the answer's enumeration, and must reply with the answer. Wrong answers may be retried up to a limit; the agent may instead reply 'HINT' to reveal a progressive hint (definition -> device -> first letter) at a scoring penalty. Reward is paid once, on the terminal step.

observation_space.description: { "clue": string, "enumeration": string e.g. "(6)" or "(3,4)", "attempts_remaining": int, "hints_remaining": int, "instructions": string, "feedback"?: string }

action_space.description: Free text: either the agent's answer, or exactly 'HINT' to reveal the next hint.

reward.description: Terminal-step reward: 1.0 correct with no hints; max(0.2, 1.0 - 0.2*hints) correct after hints; 0.3*similarity for a close-but-wrong final guess; 0.0 otherwise.
